payload.name: ExtractDistinctFactsFromSingleTurn
payload.description: When a single user message contains multiple distinct durable facts or events, use this skill during extraction to create separate candidates instead of collapsing them into one memory.
content: During candidate extraction, parse each user turn for every distinct durable fact. If a single message contains multiple independent facts (e.g., a trip and a separate breakdown), emit one candidate per fact rather than one combined candidate.

During CRUD operations, keep distinct durable facts from such candidates in separate memory entries unless they are causally inseparable; do not let one memorable event overshadow another explicit claim from the same message.

solves: During extraction, a multi-fact user utterance was collapsed into one event candidate, omitting an explicit breakdown and leaving it unanswerable. The fix is to emit separate candidates for independent durable facts in the same turn. This applies whenever one message states multiple separable facts (events, breakdowns, purchases, plans); it does not apply to splitting a single cohesive event or merging inseparable details.
